# Roman Empire: Subject-Predicate-Object Triples

## Founding & Geography
(Roman Empire, was founded, 27 BCE)
(Roman Empire, had capital, Rome)
(Roman Empire, spanned, Mediterranean region)
(Roman Empire, included territories, Europe, Africa, Asia Minor)
(Roman Empire, bordered, Atlantic Ocean, Rhine River, Danube River, Euphrates River)

## Leadership & Government
(Augustus, was first emperor, Roman Empire)
(Emperor, held title, Imperator)
(Roman Empire, was governed by, Senate and Emperor)
(Roman Empire, used system, Principate then Dominate)
(Emperor, commanded, Roman legions)

## Society & Culture
(Romans, spoke language, Latin)
(Roman Empire, practiced religion, polytheism initially; Christianity later)
(Romans, built infrastructure, roads, aqueducts, amphitheaters)
(Roman Empire, created legal system, Roman law)
(Romans, created literature, poetry, history, philosophy)

## Military
(Roman Empire, maintained force, Roman legions)
(Legion, consisted of, approximately 5,000 soldiers)
(Romans, used tactics, formations, engineering)

## Decline & Fall
(Roman Empire, fell, 476 CE in West)
(Western Roman Empire, collapsed, 476 CE)
(Eastern Roman Empire, continued as, Byzantine Empire)
(Roman Empire, lasted approximately, 500 years in West)
